t: 法国路易十二根据其前任查理八世制定的法律与布列塔尼的安妮结婚。
te: Louis XII of France marries Anne of Brittany in accordance with a law set by his predecessor, Charles VIII.
dz: 法国路易十二根据其前任查理八世制定的法律与布列塔尼的安妮结婚。
de: Louis XII of France marries Anne of Brittany in accordance with a law set by his predecessor, Charles VIII.

t: Alonso de Ojeda从Cádiz起航,前往现在的委内瑞拉.
te: Alonso de Ojeda sets sail from Cádiz on his voyage to what is now Venezuela.
dz: Alonso de Ojeda从Cádiz起航,前往现在的委内瑞拉.
de: Alonso de Ojeda sets sail from Cádiz on his voyage to what is now Venezuela.

t: 阿拉贡的凯瑟琳被代理嫁给了威尔士亲王亚瑟. 凯瑟琳是13,亚瑟是12.
te: Catherine of Aragon is married by proxy to Arthur, Prince of Wales. Catherine is 13 and Arthur is 12.
dz: 阿拉贡的凯瑟琳被代理嫁给了威尔士亲王亚瑟. 凯瑟琳是13,亚瑟是12.
de: Catherine of Aragon is married by proxy to Arthur, Prince of Wales. Catherine is 13 and Arthur is 12.

t: Amerigo Vespucci 看到了现在的巴西阿马帕州。
te: Amerigo Vespucci sights what is now Amapá State in Brazil.
dz: Amerigo Vespucci 看到了现在的巴西阿马帕州。
de: Amerigo Vespucci sights what is now Amapá State in Brazil.

t: 葡萄牙探险家尼古拉·科埃略(Nicolau Coelho)在发现作为瓦斯科·达·加马的同伴前往…
te: The Portuguese explorer Nicolau Coelho returns to Lisbon after discovering the sea route to India as a companion of Vas…
dz: 葡萄牙探险家尼古拉·科埃略(Nicolau Coelho)在发现作为瓦斯科·达·加马的同伴前往印度的出海路线后返回了里斯本.
de: The Portuguese explorer Nicolau Coelho returns to Lisbon after discovering the sea route to India as a companion of Vasco da Gama.

t: 瑞士人决定性地击败了神圣罗马皇帝马克西米利安一世的军队.
te: The Swiss decisively defeat the army of Maximilian I, Holy Roman Emperor.
dz: 多纳克之战:瑞士人决定性地击败了神圣罗马皇帝马克西米利安一世的军队.
de: Battle of Dornach: The Swiss decisively defeat the army of Maximilian I, Holy Roman Emperor.

t: 威尼斯和奥斯曼舰队第一次接战"宗奇奥之战".
te: First engagement of the Battle of Zonchio between Venetian and Ottoman fleets.
dz: 威尼斯和奥斯曼舰队第一次接战"宗奇奥之战".
de: First engagement of the Battle of Zonchio between Venetian and Ottoman fleets.

t: 里斯本市民庆祝探险家瓦斯科·德·伽马凯旋归来，完成了他绕好望角前往印度的两年旅程。
te: The citizens of Lisbon celebrate the triumphal return of the explorer Vasco de Gama, completing his two-year journey ar…
dz: 里斯本市民庆祝探险家瓦斯科·德·伽马凯旋归来，完成了他绕好望角前往印度的两年旅程。
de: The citizens of Lisbon celebrate the triumphal return of the explorer Vasco de Gama, completing his two-year journey around the Cape of Good Hope to India.

t: 《巴塞尔条约》结束了斯瓦比战争.
te: The Treaty of Basel concludes the Swabian War.
dz: 《巴塞尔条约》结束了斯瓦比战争.
de: The Treaty of Basel concludes the Swabian War.

t: 1464年由杰汉·拉加多克(Jehan Lagadeuc)在特莱吉耶尔所写的"天主教"被出版;…
te: The Catholicon, written in 1464 by Jehan Lagadeuc in Tréguier, is published; this is the first Breton dictionary as wel…
dz: 1464年由杰汉·拉加多克(Jehan Lagadeuc)在特莱吉耶尔所写的"天主教"被出版;这是第一部布雷通词典以及第一部法国词典.
de: The Catholicon, written in 1464 by Jehan Lagadeuc in Tréguier, is published; this is the first Breton dictionary as well as the first French dictionary.

t: 在被判叛国罪7天后,伪装出英格兰王位的珀金·沃贝克(Perkin Warbeck)因试图从伦敦…
te: Seven days after being convicted of treason, Perkin Warbeck, a pretender to the throne of England, is hanged for attemp…
dz: 在被判叛国罪7天后,伪装出英格兰王位的珀金·沃贝克(Perkin Warbeck)因试图从伦敦塔逃跑被绞死;他的支持者约翰·阿特沃特被处死.
de: Seven days after being convicted of treason, Perkin Warbeck, a pretender to the throne of England, is hanged for attempting to escape from the Tower of London; his supporter John Atwater is executed with him.

t: 针对西班牙穆斯林被强迫皈依,阿尔普亚拉斯爆发了叛乱.
te: A rebellion breaks out in Alpujarras in response to the forced conversions of Muslims in Spain.
dz: 针对西班牙穆斯林被强迫皈依,阿尔普亚拉斯爆发了叛乱.
de: A rebellion breaks out in Alpujarras in response to the forced conversions of Muslims in Spain.
